Subject: SablePoint pilot — request: top-up + short extension

Hi Cody,

Thanks again for the productive session yesterday — the integration looks solid and the engineering team reported smoother inference latency on the longer sequences after we applied the prefix-caching tweak. A couple of asks from your side came up during testing and I wanted to capture them formally so we can move to the approval step: 

- Top-up: your trial is ~85% consumed due to the larger-than-expected evaluation set. You asked for an immediate 30,000-unit credit top-up to finish the remaining validation runs.
- Short extension: you also requested a 2-week extension on the pilot evaluation window so your data team can run the final regression checks across the new model prompt set.

We usually handle small top-ups without escalation, but because this would be combined with a promotional discount to accelerate the post-pilot purchase (you asked about a short introductory rate for months 1–3), I need exec clearance as this exceeds the standard approval thresholds.

Why this makes sense (brief): SablePoint’s projected 12‑month ARR on success is >$600k with clear expansion pathways in RevOps and Customer Insights. The extra credit will let them complete the regression suite and finalize their internal buy-in. The extension is specifically to run the final data-parity checks that will be referenced in their security review.

Attachments: I’ve attached a one‑page deal summary and the current PO from RevOps (SablePoint_PO_v1.pdf) for context.

Can you confirm whether we can approve a 30k credit top‑up + a 15% promotional discount on token pricing for the first 3 months conditional on them signing a 6‑month committed volume agreement? If that needs to be carved down, please advise alternatives (credit amount or discount level) — I’ll pass it back to the customer.

Next step: if you’re good with the proposal I’ll route for formal credit issuance and update HubSpot.

Thanks,

Mina
